messages:
anya: FYI i just finished a call with ACMEHealth. they want a lightweight 'Optimize Advisor' pilot that: suggests batch/cache/quant settings, gives quick cost/latency delta, and can wire eval-triggered alerts into their ops channel. they asked for a pilot in ~6 weeks.

sam: sounds good. can we scope a lean MVP vs. a broader v1? lean = rule-based recommender + eval-alert infra. v1 = policy engine + runtime signals + ML ranker.

devon: lean MVP checklist (engineering view):
- profiler docker that samples 10k tokens and emits workload summary (qps, median len, openai/llm call shape)
- rules engine service (REST) that maps profiles -> bucketed recs (batch_size, kv_cache toggle, quant_profile)
- estimator util that returns expected p50/p95 latency and relative token-cost delta
- alert hook endpoint for eval results -> triggers ops notification + rollback recs

kira: acceptance criteria proposal:
- recommender API latency <=200ms for typical profile payloads
- recommended config yields >=10% median per-token cost reduction on internal sample set OR no worse than baseline quality (measured by eval set)
- eval-alerts: true-positive rate >=95% for injected regressions, false-positive rate <=0.1% on stable evals
- documented canary flow for Dedicated+Hosted dev tiers

marta: security/enterprise asks: must include request-level audit logs, customer-scoped feature flags, and IAM check for private deployments. also need a consent step before automatic rollback.

anya: good catch. add mandatory pre-rollout eval-hook for quant/ablation recommendations. also, risk notes: quant profiles can degrade model outputs for certain tasks (summarization, code). mitigation: require eval confidence thresholds and auto-fallback to baseline model on quality drop.

sam: prioritization: Q2 alpha = lean MVP (rules engine + eval-alert infra + profiler). Q3 = ML ranker + autosuggest rollouts + telemetry-driven heuristics.

devon: sample response shape (for API doc):
{
  "recommended_batch_size": 8,
  "kv_cache": "on",
  "quant_profile": "int8_fast",
  "expected_latency_ms": { "p50": 85, "p95": 160 },
  "expected_cost_delta_pct": "-14%",
  "confidence": "low|med|high"
}

kira: onboarding flow: customer runs profiler image -> uploads workload summary -> advisor returns recs + a simulated cost/latency table and suggested eval set. customer can opt-in to canary (traffic-split) or run a dry-run.

anya: ops playbook skeleton:
- pre-check: run eval-hook against registered prompt set
- canary: 1% traffic for 1 hour -> check eval metrics and latency SLOs
- escalate: if eval or p99 latency regressions occur, auto-fallback and page oncall

infra-bot: ticket INF-820 created for profiler infra (owner: devon). ticket SEC-211 created for audit-logging + IAM (owner: marta).

marta: i'll triage SEC-211 and post required privacy checklist.

sam: can we estimate implementation effort? devon: 3w for profiler + 2w for rules engine + 1w for eval-alert plumbing = ~6w (alpha).

anya: ok i'll write a one-pager PRD with scope options and acceptance criteria and share it here. propose a 30min sync with eng/ops next Tue. @sam @devon @kira please confirm availability.

sam: confirmed :thumbsup:

devon: confirmed. i'll start the profiler prototype tonight.

kira: confirmed. i'll draft eval sets and thresholds.

anya: thanks — i'll post the PRD and meeting invite in this thread shortly.
